rules.title: Brown Act — covered open-meeting recording
rules.summary: Existing qualified California meeting research addresses recording protection and the statutory persistent-disruption standard. This is not an all-hours room-access or lobby rule.
open_questions: Current Council implementation, equipment rules, and actual meeting venue.

rules.title: Brown Act — public comment and criticism
rules.summary: Statutory comment and criticism protection must be reconciled with current local timing, subject, sign-in, decorum, and removal procedures.

cpra_targets.target: Current City Hall visitor/recording directives, Council procedures, chamber reservation rules, and incorporated signage policies not available online.
cpra_targets.why: Meeting-specific rights must remain distinct from service-lobby and nonmeeting uses.

cpra_targets.target: Correct City Hall parcel/title/control documents and Grove Street frontage/right-of-way and entrance plans.
cpra_targets.why: Address-only GIS results were in the wrong locality and cannot establish this property.
